channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Microsoft faces reckoning for assisting Israel’s genocide in Gaza
item.description: A new legal and shareholder campaign warns that Microsoft’s military contracts expose the company and its executives to international and domestic liability.

item.title: Clinton blames young people and social media for opposition to Gaza genocide
item.description: A speech at a far right Israeli publication’s summit sparks criticism over claims that youth are misinformed rather than responding to documented atrocities.

item.title: Trump administration threatens to withhold SNAP funds from democratic-led states
item.description: A new confrontation between the White House and blue states raises concerns about the political use of food assistance programs.

item.title: Nineteen states to raise minimum wage on Jan. 1
item.description: While some states will reach a $15 minimum wage for the first time, other states will have a minimum wage of $15 or higher as of January 1, 2026.
